steps.step_name: Assess whether the computer can be repaired or should be returned without repair
Start hardware diagnostics
Continue with the repair after diagnostics
Order the needed hardware component if unavailable
Install the component and continue diagnostics
Check and configure software as needed
Test system functionality after repairs
Return repaired computer to the customer

exceptions.recovery: Order the component and inform the customer about the delay

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Some configurations didn't take effect or new software problems emerged
Billing software errors during the process

steps.step_name: Use billing software to calculate the repair cost based on parts and labor
If software errors occur, manually calculate costs and update the system

exceptions.recovery: Manually calculate the costs and ensure the system is updated correctly

steps.step_name: Test the repaired computer with a System Testing Suite
Check that all hardware components are functioning correctly
Check that software configurations are properly applied
Reconfigure software or troubleshoot new issues as needed, then retest

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Software configurations didn't apply correctly or new issues surfaced
exceptions.impact: Testing fails or reveals new problems
Delays the process and requires further troubleshooting
exceptions.recovery: Troubleshoot further and make additional adjustments

steps.step_name: Use the supplier's online ordering system to select and order the needed part
Track delivery status and update the customer about expected arrival times
Follow up with the supplier for updates if needed

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Delays from the supplier or the part is on backorder
exceptions.recovery: Stay in touch with the supplier for updates and keep the customer informed about further delays

steps.step_name: Contact the customer to explain delays due to unavailable components
Provide ongoing updates to the customer about order status or expected arrival times
Discuss reasons when a repair isn’t feasible so the customer understands the decision
Generate an invoice based on parts and labor costs
Manually calculate repair costs if the billing software malfunctions
Update the system with the correct amount and provide the final cost to the customer

exceptions.impact: Leads to inaccurate cost estimates and adds extra work/time
exceptions.recovery: Manually calculate the costs and update the system correctly

steps.step_name: Discuss the situation with the customer to explain why it's not feasible to repair
Prepare the computer for return
Provide any necessary documentation
Return the computer to the customer

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Customers may be upset or disappointed about not getting a repair
exceptions.recovery: Communicate clearly and offer any possible alternatives or advice
